description: This file defines an abstract class 'SugarRelationship' which serves as the base for relationship handling between modules in the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for adding, removing, loading, and querying relationships, as well as managing related beans and hooks.

classes.name: SugarRelationship
classes.description: An abstract base class for managing module relationships, providing core functionalities for adding, removing, loading, and querying relationships in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Abstract method to add a relationship between two beans (modules).

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Abstract method to remove a relationship between two beans.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Abstract method to load related records for a given link.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the query used to load related data.

methods.name: getJoin
methods.description: Abstract method to get the SQL join clause for related modules.

methods.name: relationship_exists
methods.description: Abstract method to check if a relationship exists between two beans.

methods.name: getRelationshipTable
methods.description: Abstract method to get the name of the relationship table.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes all related beans from a given link.

methods.name: removeById
methods.description: Removes a relationship row by its ID.

methods.name: getRHSModule
methods.description: Returns the name of the right-hand side module in the relationship.

methods.name: getLHSModule
methods.description: Returns the name of the left-hand side module in the relationship.

methods.name: getLHSLink
methods.description: Returns the link name on the LHS.

methods.name: getRHSLink
methods.description: Returns the link name on the RHS.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns the fields involved in the relationship.

methods.name: addRow
methods.description: Adds a new row to the relationship table or updates an existing one.

methods.name: updateRow
methods.description: Updates a specific row in the relationship table.

methods.name: removeRow
methods.description: Marks a row as deleted in the relationship table.

methods.name: checkExisting
methods.description: Checks if a relationship row already exists for given beans.

methods.name: getRoleWhere
methods.description: Constructs a SQL clause to filter relationships by role column.

methods.name: getCustomLogicArguments
methods.description: Gathers arguments for relationship-related logic hooks.

methods.name: callBeforeAdd
methods.description: Invokes the pre-add hook before adding a relationship.

methods.name: callAfterAdd
methods.description: Invokes the post-add hook after adding a relationship.

methods.name: callBeforeDelete
methods.description: Invokes the pre-delete hook before removing a relationship.

methods.name: callAfterDelete
methods.description: Invokes the post-delete hook after removing a relationship.

methods.name: getOptionalWhereClause
methods.description: Builds a WHERE clause from optional filtering parameters.

methods.name: addToResaveList
methods.description: Adds a bean to a static list for later re-saving.

methods.name: resaveRelatedBeans
methods.description: Resaves all beans in the static list, used to propagate changes.

methods.name: isParentRelationship
methods.description: Determines if this relationship is a parent (flex relate) type.
